Method of Attack: payment card scraper or skimmer script loaded on store checkout pages to secretly record payment card details entered in payment forms and send data to a server under hacker's control
Attack Vector: modification of source code on Magento stores to load malicious script
Indicators of Compromise: MagentoCore script found on 7,339 Magento stores
MagentoCore script found on 5,172 domains at time of writing
